    • extractFilterMap

      @Nullable public @Nullable Map<String,Object> extractFilterMap(@Nullable @Nullable Object parsed)
      Given the result of parseJson(String), extracts the filter map.

      If the parsed value is a Map it is returned directly. If it is a pipeline List, the $match stage map is returned, or an empty map when no $match stage is present (= match all). Returns null for any other type.

      Parameters:
      parsed - the parsed JSON structure
      Returns:
      the extracted filter map, an empty map for a pipeline without $match, or null

    • extractGroupFieldPath

      @Nullable public @Nullable String extractGroupFieldPath(@Nullable @Nullable String jsonQuery)
      Extract the distinct-count group field path from a pipeline query.

      A COUNT_DISTINCT over a property is encoded as a $group stage whose _id is the $-prefixed field path. Returns that path (without the $ prefix), or null when the query is not a property-scoped distinct count (e.g. count over the root, or no pipeline).

      Parameters:
      jsonQuery - the JSON query string
      Returns:
      the field path to count distinct values of, or null

    • extractGroupFieldPath

      Returns:
      the field path to count distinct values of, or null

    • extractProjectionField

      @Nullable public @Nullable String extractProjectionField(@Nullable @Nullable String jsonQuery)
      Extract the projection field from a JSON query that uses $project syntax.

      Example usage in repository method: 

      @Query("{\"$project\": \"name\", \"active\": {\"$eq\": true}}")
List<String> findActivePersonNames();
      Parameters:
      jsonQuery - the JSON query string
      Returns:
      the field name to project, or null if not using $project syntax

    • extractProjectionFields

      public List<String> extractProjectionFields(@Nullable @Nullable String jsonQuery)
      Extract projection fields from a JSON query that uses $project syntax. The returned list preserves the order emitted by the query builder.
      Parameters:
      jsonQuery - the JSON query string
      Returns:
      projected field names, or an empty list if no projection is present

    • extractProjectionFields

      public List<String> extractProjectionFields(@Nullable @Nullable Object parsed)
      Extract projection fields from an already-parsed JSON query structure that uses $project syntax, bypassing the JSON parse step. Used by callers that already parsed the query string for another purpose (e.g. the filter map) and want to avoid re-parsing the same text.
      Parameters:
      parsed - the result of parseJson(String)
      Returns:
      projected field names, or an empty list if no projection is present

    • extractProjectionFields

      public List<String> extractProjectionFields(@Nullable @Nullable Map<String,Object> projection)
      Extract projection fields directly from an already-built projection map (field name to 1/true when included), bypassing the JSON parse step. Used by the runtime Criteria fast path, which already has the map in hand and never serialized it to text.
      Parameters:
      projection - the projection map
      Returns:
      projected field names, or an empty list if no projection is present
